verdict.rationale: Segment supports event-driven automation indirectly. Functions run custom JavaScript destinations on incoming events, and Audiences defined by event and trait rules sync automatically to downstream destinations, including 'Actions'-based destinations. The evidence never documents an explicit rule or trigger builder (if event X matches condition Y, perform action Z), so the story is only partly evidenced. Missing for 10: a documented trigger/condition rule engine with configurable actions, detail on how Actions mappings fire on events, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
